brief:
Two significant Arabic literary works are appearing in English translation this August, ArabLit reported. A new collection assembles one-act plays by Naguib Mahfouz, the Egyptian writer and Nobel laureate whose fiction explored Cairo's social landscape across decades. The second title is a novel by Sara Abu Ghazal, a Palestinian author whose work joins a growing body of Palestinian fiction reaching English-speaking audiences.

The releases underscore sustained international interest in Arabic literature beyond the region's borders. Both works represent different traditions within modern Arabic writing—Mahfouz's theatrical output and contemporary Palestinian narrative—now accessible to readers unfamiliar with the original language.
dek: Two notable Arabic books are coming in English translation this month: a collection of one-act plays by Naguib Mahfouz and a novel by Sara Abu Ghazal.
title: English translations bring Mahfouz plays and Palestinian fiction to readers
